reports.title: Architect report: bootstrap (T-000)
reports.summary: Defined the system, stack, data model, API contract, local and AWS layout, and split the manager view into four buildable tickets. No application code was written; implementers build from these documents.

items.label: ARCHITECTURE.md
items.text: 199 lines. The system's memory: overview, components, verified versions, data model, API conventions, patterns, personas and permissions, auth, AWS layout, local run, key decisions, dependency deferrals.

items.label: specs/T-000-bootstrap.md
items.text: Repo layout, versions, Makefile targets, local environment, API contract workflow, cross-cutting concerns, testing strategy, Terraform module plan, implementation tickets.

items.label: specs/T-001-manager-view.md
items.text: Feature spec: data model with columns, mock data volumes, API, backend rules, shared code, web screens and states, test notes, assumptions A1 to A9.

items.label: api/openapi.yaml
items.text: 761 lines, OpenAPI 3.1. Passes redocly lint (one warning: /health has no 4xx response). A TypeScript client was generated from it as a check.

items.label: tickets/T-001a to T-001d
items.text: Four implementation tickets in Given/When/Then, ordered and independently verifiable.

items.label: Terraform over CDK.
items.text: Reviewable plan diffs for humans and the code-review agent, no synth step, mature AWS provider, S3 native state locking. IaC is specified only; not written in Phase 1.

items.label: Contract first.
items.text: Hand-written OpenAPI 3.1 is the single source of truth. The backend is tested against it and the TypeScript client is generated from it, with a drift check that fails the lint if they disagree.

items.label: Auth (Phase 1).
items.text: Seeded users, argon2id password hashes, HS256 JWT valid for 30 minutes, no refresh token. Role is reloaded from the database on every request. Painter gets 403 on manager endpoints, no token gets 401.

items.label: Monorepo.
items.text: npm workspaces for shared, web and e2e; backend managed by uv; Makefile and scripts/dev.sh as entry points. Generated client code is committed.

items.label: Local and cloud parity.
items.text: docker compose runs db, migrate, seed, backend and web (nginx) with one command. A no-Docker path (scripts/dev.sh) exists for this workspace. Web config.js is generated at container start from API_BASE_URL.

items.label: AWS layout.
items.text: VPC over 2 AZs, ECS Fargate behind an ALB, RDS Postgres 16 in private subnets, S3 plus CloudFront for the web build, Secrets Manager, GitHub OIDC roles for CI/CD, migrations as a one-off ECS task before each deploy.

items.label: Photos.
items.text: Generated SVG placeholders served through short-lived signed URLs. This matches the later S3 presigned-URL shape, needs no image dependencies and works offline.

items.label: Sync SQLAlchemy with psycopg 3.
items.text: Read-only and low traffic, so sync is simpler to test.

items.label: Plain CSS, system fonts, no UI kit.
items.text: Keeps the app small and fully offline.

items.label: CORS allowlist instead of a same-origin proxy.
items.text: Mirrors production, where CloudFront and the API are on different domains.

items.label: Derived invoice status.
items.text: Overdue and part-paid are computed by one pure function (void, draft, paid, overdue, part-paid, sent), so they always match payments and today's date.

items.label: Injectable clock.
items.text: FIXED_NOW (non-production only) makes 'this month' figures deterministic in tests.

blocks.heading: Design patterns chosen
rows: Photo bytes and URLs differ per phase and environment
shared/src/auth/tokenStore.ts (web sessionStorage now, SecureStore on mobile later)
Keeps generated code untouched; base URL, bearer header and Problem errors handled once
Role-only rules need no pattern yet; revisit as per-persona Policy when painter ownership rules arrive
No transitions in Phase 1, so State would be over-engineering

items.label: A1
items.text: All 60 seeded jobs are completed and each has one completion report.

items.label: A2
items.text: 'Status' filtering covers review status and billing status, with separate filters.

items.label: A3
items.text: 'This month' is the current calendar month in Europe/London. Outstanding is the unpaid balance of issued, non-void invoices; overdue includes part-paid.

items.label: A4
items.text: 20% VAT. Payment terms 14 days for homeowners and 30 days for landlords and businesses. A paid deposit is deducted on the invoice.

items.label: A5
items.text: Billing 'amount' is the invoice total after deposit; 'paid' is payments against the invoice; deposits show on the report detail.

items.label: A6
items.text: Roles are exclusive; a painter signing in to the web app sees a 'managers only' page.

items.label: A7
items.text: Mock region is Bristol and Bath. Seed dates are relative to the seed date so current-month figures always exist.

items.label: A8
items.text: 'Awaiting review' means not yet reviewed by a manager; Phase 1 has no review action.

items.label: A9
items.text: Sessions last 30 minutes with no refresh.

items.text: backend/Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml (db, migrate, seed, backend, web with healthchecks and dependency conditions), .env.example, Makefile, scripts/dev.sh (also supports SKIP_WEB, WEB_PORT, BACKEND_PORT), infra and mobile READMEs.

items.label: Workspaces.
items.text: Root npm workspaces (shared, web, e2e) with scripts gen, gen:check, lint, test, build and e2e.

items.label: Shared.
items.text: Generated API client committed under shared/src/generated, an adapter (runtime base URL, bearer token, 15 second timeout), ApiError and a useHealth hook.

items.label: Web shell.
items.text: Loads /config.js before the app; shows 'JobProof' and 'API: ok' through the generated client, with loading and error states and a Try again button. Plain CSS, no external assets; a test scans the production build for external origins.

items.label: Container.
items.text: web/Dockerfile is multi-stage and non-root with a healthcheck. The nginx entrypoint writes config.js and the content security policy from API_BASE_URL and rejects malformed values.

items.label: e2e.
items.text: Playwright config, two tests and a README. Uses the installed Chrome at /usr/bin/google-chrome.
A harmless Starlette test-client warning about httpx2 is ignored in pytest config.
pyjwt and argon2-cffi are not added yet; T-001c adds them when first used.
HTTP 405 maps to the error code not_found because the contract has no method-not-allowed code.
The web dist scan allows w3.org namespaces and a few harmless library message strings, and skips config.js because it holds the API origin by design.
The nginx image tag is stable-alpine because Docker Hub was unreachable; it should be pinned to an exact tag on a machine with access.
npm audit flags transitive issues in the Redocly CLI dev tool (js-yaml, minimatch). Not fixed; dev-only and for the code reviewer and architect to triage.

reports.title: Code review report: T-001a
reports.summary: Round 1: CHANGES REQUESTED (1 blocker, 1 major, 5 minor). All were fixed and verified. Round 2: APPROVE, with three small follow-ups carried forward.

blocks.heading: Round 1 findings and resolution
rows: npm audit: high and moderate vulnerabilities in dev tooling (js-yaml via @hey-api/openapi-ts, minimatch via eslint and typescript-eslint)
Architect decided on npm overrides (js-yaml ^4.3.2, minimatch ^11.0.1). npm audit now reports 0 vulnerabilities; lint still catches planted errors. Recorded in ARCHITECTURE.md 12.1
nginx entrypoint: multi-line API_BASE_URL passed the origin check and could inject nginx directives and break config.js
Control characters rejected before an anchored check; 18 hostile inputs now covered by an automated test. Re-tested by the reviewer with 20+ hostile inputs under sh, dash and bash
dev.sh e2e could reuse a Vite dev server instead of the production build
Web mode recorded in .dev/web.mode; web restarts if the mode differs
Cannot pin without registry access; TODO(pin) comments added. On the handover list
Bundle URL allowlist did not match the spec
Architect fixed the spec to seven exact strings; scanner now uses exact equality with a near-miss test
503 health test did not assert the 3 second limit
Timed assertion added, plus a blackhole-address test (skips in this sandbox)
Reads POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_DB from the environment

items.text: All round 1 issues verified fixed. No new blockers or majors.
Areas found sound in round 1: CORS allowlist, non-root containers, exec-form commands, compose dependency chain (healthy, then completed, then healthy), generated client matches the contract.
nginx entrypoint still accepts nonsense hosts such as http://-. Stricter host-label check and a 253 character cap to be added in T-001d (web owner).
Add $(), backtick, unicode lookalike, uppercase scheme and very long values to the nginx script test (T-001d).
The blackhole timeout test skips here. It needs a CI environment where it runs, or a local socket that accepts but never replies.
Pin Docker base image tags and digests on a machine with registry access.

reports.title: Architect report: end-of-Phase 1 architecture update

No application code, tests or contract were changed.

rows: react-router's bundled warning text contains https://github.com/ungap/url-search-params. and the exact-string allowlist would reject it. Keep the hook. To use useSearchParams later, add that string to spec T-000 7.1, T-001a scenario 5 and web/scripts/dist-origins.mjs

items.label: Secret guard.
items.text: When APP_ENV is not local or test, JWT_SECRET and PHOTO_URL_SECRET must be set explicitly. They are rejected if they are dev defaults, start with dev-only- (any case), have surrounding whitespace, or are equal to each other (ignoring case). Production also refuses demo accounts and FIXED_NOW.

items.label: APP_ENV.
items.text: Required, with no default; must be exactly local, test, staging or production.

items.label: Seed guard.
items.text: The seed runs only when APP_ENV is local or test, so staging has no demo data. A staging demo dataset needs an explicit decision.

items.label: NUL characters.
items.text: Rejected with 422 in the login fields and the q search parameter.

items.label: safeRedirect.
items.text: Only same-origin paths are accepted. Control characters, backslashes, // and /login targets are refused.

items.label: CSP.
items.text: Generated by web/nginx/40-jobproof-config.sh, with strict API_BASE_URL host rules. Covered by the config-script unit test and e2e/tests/csp.spec.ts.

items.label: Demo accounts endpoint.
items.text: Returns 404 unless DEMO_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is set. The config refuses it when APP_ENV is production.

reports.title: Code review report: T-001b, T-001c and T-001d
reports.summary: Data model and API (T-001b/c): round 1 CHANGES REQUESTED with 3 major issues, all fixed and re-verified. Web UI (T-001d): round 1 CHANGES REQUESTED with 2 major issues, fixed; round 2 APPROVE. No blockers at any point.

blocks.heading: T-001b and T-001c, round 1 (3 MAJOR)
rows: Production secret guard accepted the published development secrets, so anyone reading the repo could forge a manager login
Startup now fails outside local and test if a secret is a dev default, starts dev-only-, matches the other secret, has surrounding whitespace or differs only by case
python -m app.seed empties every table with no environment check
Seed refuses to run unless APP_ENV is local or test, before touching the database. Staging gets no demo data
A NUL character in a sign-in email, password or search term caused a 500 instead of a validation error
Rejected with 422 problem+json on login and on every text or typed parameter of the manager endpoints
Invoice customer matching the job's customer is not enforced by the database
page parameter has no upper bound
Needs a contract change; recorded as backlog B1

blocks.heading: T-001d, round 1 (2 MAJOR) and round 2 (APPROVE)
rows: Login redirect check could be beaten with tab, CR or LF characters, which crashed the app after sign-in
Redirect now resolves against the origin, requires same origin and rejects control characters and backslashes. Reviewer re-tested 18 hostile values in real Chrome
Billing and reports tables were clipped at 768px with no sign they scroll
Cells no longer wrap, secondary details are stacked, and a visible scroll cue appears when a table overflows. Measured at 360 to 1024px; orchestrator took fresh screenshots
Control characters in a shared ?q= link caused an error that Retry could never fix
Abort signals now reach the SDK; 6 superseded requests were cancelled in the reviewer's test
Signed photo links expire after 15 minutes and never recovered
One throttled refetch (at most once a minute) on image error
e2e origin guard missed popups and service workers; security policy never tested
Guard now covers the whole browser context; new CSP spec loads all five pages under the generated policy with zero violations and proves the policy is enforced
nginx host check accepted bad ports, 64 character labels and numeric hosts

items.label: Fixed.
items.text: Startup validation errors printed setting values, which could put a too-short secret into the logs. Values are now hidden, with a regression test that fails without the fix.

items.label: Open (architect).
items.text: AbortSignal.any needs Chrome 116, Firefox 124 or Safari 17.4. Write a supported-browser policy into ARCHITECTURE.md before the mobile app reuses shared/ (React Native does not provide it).

items.label: Open (low).
items.text: The demo-accounts setting is blocked only in production, so staging could switch it on and list accounts the seed never creates there.

items.label: Accepted.
items.text: Unicode zero-width variants of the dev secret are not rejected. They would have to be deliberate, so not worth chasing.
Sign-in tokens: algorithm pinned, issuer, audience and expiry required, role and active status reloaded from the database on every request.
Uniform sign-in errors and timing; argon2id defaults; signed photo URLs with constant-time comparison and separate secret.
Search wildcard escaping, SQL status filters matching the pure billing functions, stable sorting, London month boundaries and clock changes.
Web: no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, all links internal, sessionStorage token, 401 handling and cache clearing, generated client used throughout, money from integer pence.

reports.title: Engineers' report: T-001b, T-001c and T-001d (manager view)
reports.summary: The manager can sign in, see a dashboard, browse and filter job reports, inspect photo evidence and review billing, all on realistic Bristol and Bath mock data. Verified from a clean start: lint clean, 337 backend tests, 159 frontend tests, 48 browser tests, npm audit 0.

blocks.heading: Mock data actually seeded (deterministic, safe to re-run)
rows: about 400 generated placeholders (before, during, after; one report has none)
52 in total: 30 paid, 7 sent, 6 draft, 6 overdue, 2 part paid, 1 void; 8 jobs not yet invoiced

items.label: Database.
items.text: Nine tables in one reversible Alembic migration with enums, constraints and indexes; models in SQLAlchemy 2.

items.label: Billing logic.
items.text: Pure functions derive invoice status (void, draft, paid, overdue, part paid, sent); SQL filters are tested to agree with them across 7 different 'today' dates.

items.label: API.
items.text: Login, current user, demo accounts, dashboard, painters, reports (pagination, filters, search), report detail, invoices, and signed expiring photo URLs. Query counts stay at 6 or fewer however many rows are returned.

items.label: Photos.
items.text: Generated SVG images behind a PhotoStore strategy, so S3 can replace them later without changing callers.

items.label: Security.
items.text: JWT with pinned algorithm, argon2id passwords with uniform errors, role checked from the database on every request, secrets guarded outside local and test, seed refuses to run outside local and test, APP_ENV required.

items.label: Pages.
items.text: Login (shows demo accounts), dashboard (5 figures plus recent reports), reports (search, review, billing, painter and date filters, pagination, all kept in the URL), report detail (job, customer, painter, checklist, photo gallery with keyboard-operable enlarge view, quote, invoice, payments), billing list.

items.label: Behaviour.
items.text: Painters see a 'managers only' page; an expired session returns to login with a notice; every page has loading, empty and error states with Retry.

items.label: Look.
items.text: Plain CSS, warm paper palette, serif headings, status badges with text and icons (never colour alone), system fonts, no external assets, responsive to tablet width.

items.label: Shared code.
items.text: Generated client, hooks, TokenStore, filter parsing and GBP and en-GB formatting live in shared/ for the future mobile app.
